name: kopia
description: Content-addressed, client-side-encrypted backup engine (kopia) wrapped behind the resource-kopia CLI. Provides deduplicated, compressed, encrypted snapshots to filesystem and S3/MinIO repositories for the data-backup-manager scenario.

limitations: The upstream executable, licensing, authentication, and version policy are host-managed.
The upstream executable, licensing, authentication, and version policy are host-managed.

linux: set -euo pipefail; KOPIA_VERSION=0.23.0; DEST="${HOME:?HOME not set}/.vrooli/bin"; BIN="$DEST/kopia"; if [ -x "$BIN" ] && "$BIN" --version 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$KOPIA_VERSION"; then echo "kopia $KOPIA_VERSION already installed at $BIN"; exit 0; fi; arch=$(uname -m); case "$arch" in x86_64|amd64) karch=x64 ;; aarch64|arm64) karch=arm64 ;; armv7l|armhf|arm) karch=arm ;; *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $arch" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; asset="kopia-${KOPIA_VERSION}-linux-${karch}.tar.gz"; base="https://github.com/kopia/kopia/releases/download/v${KOPIA_VERSION}"; tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT; curl -fsSL "$base/$asset" -o "$tmp/$asset"; curl -fsSL "$base/checksums.txt" -o "$tmp/checksums.txt"; if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then (cd "$tmp" && grep " $asset$" checksums.txt | sha256sum -c -); else (cd "$tmp" && grep " $asset$" checksums.txt | shasum -a 256 -c -); fi; tar -xzf "$tmp/$asset" -C "$tmp"; mkdir -p "$DEST"; install -m 0755 "$tmp/${asset%.tar.gz}/kopia" "$BIN"; echo "installed kopia $KOPIA_VERSION to $BIN"
macos: set -euo pipefail; KOPIA_VERSION=0.23.0; DEST="${HOME:?HOME not set}/.vrooli/bin"; BIN="$DEST/kopia"; if [ -x "$BIN" ] && "$BIN" --version 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$KOPIA_VERSION"; then echo "kopia $KOPIA_VERSION already installed at $BIN"; exit 0; fi; arch=$(uname -m); case "$arch" in arm64) karch=arm64 ;; x86_64) karch=x64 ;; *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $arch" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; asset="kopia-${KOPIA_VERSION}-macOS-${karch}.tar.gz"; base="https://github.com/kopia/kopia/releases/download/v${KOPIA_VERSION}"; tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT; curl -fsSL "$base/$asset" -o "$tmp/$asset"; curl -fsSL "$base/checksums.txt" -o "$tmp/checksums.txt"; if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then (cd "$tmp" && grep " $asset$" checksums.txt | sha256sum -c -); else (cd "$tmp" && grep " $asset$" checksums.txt | shasum -a 256 -c -); fi; tar -xzf "$tmp/$asset" -C "$tmp"; mkdir -p "$DEST"; install -m 0755 "$tmp/${asset%.tar.gz}/kopia" "$BIN"; echo "installed kopia $KOPIA_VERSION to $BIN"
windows: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $v='0.23.0'; $dest=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.vrooli\bin'; $bin=Join-Path $dest 'kopia.exe'; if (Test-Path $bin) { $cur = & $bin --version 2>$null; if ($cur -match [regex]::Escape($v)) { Write-Output "kopia $v already installed at $bin"; exit 0 } }; $asset="kopia-$v-windows-x64.zip"; $base="https://github.com/kopia/kopia/releases/download/v$v"; $tmp=(New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Join-Path ([System.IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ([System.Guid]::NewGuid().ToString()))).FullName; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "$base/$asset" -OutFile (Join-Path $tmp $asset); Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "$base/checksums.txt" -OutFile (Join-Path $tmp 'checksums.txt'); $want=(((Select-String -Path (Join-Path $tmp 'checksums.txt') -Pattern ([regex]::Escape($asset))).Line) -split '\s+')[0]; $got=(Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -Path (Join-Path $tmp $asset)).Hash.ToLower(); if ($got -ne $want.ToLower()) { throw "checksum mismatch for $asset" }; Expand-Archive -Path (Join-Path $tmp $asset) -DestinationPath $tmp -Force; $exe=Get-ChildItem -Path $tmp -Recurse -Filter 'kopia.exe' | Select-Object -First 1; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dest | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Path $exe.FullName -Destination $bin -Force; Write-Output "installed kopia $v to $bin"

env.label: Kopia repository passphrase
env.description: Per-repository client-side encryption passphrase. System-generated (32+ chars) on repo creation and stored in Vault; never user-typed and never written to a config file. Without it, an encrypted repository cannot be opened.

env.label: S3 access key ID
env.description: Access key for an S3/MinIO-compatible backend. Only required for repositories created with --backend s3.

env.label: S3 secret access key
env.description: Secret key for an S3/MinIO-compatible backend. Only required for repositories created with --backend s3.
